limitations: P2P capability and copy bandwidth do not identify the physical peer route; PyTorch does not expose XGMI link type.
When RCCL peer IPC fails, auto mode explicitly retries with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1; this uses a host-staged transport and is reported rather than presented as direct peer collective speed.
The training input is deterministic synthetic data, while the model and global batch follow the representative paper workload.
Fixed global batch measures strong scaling; it is not four independent jobs and not weak-scaling aggregate throughput.
